t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the red coloured gnomes seem to award more points (red, orange and so on) compared to other gnomes.  For other colours, brown seemed to fair better

vb_textbox.text: The advice I was given was to choose the gnomes that had the red colours so red, orange, purple. I started off choosing the reds then choosing other colours to try and gauge any difference.To me, it seemed fairly random no matter what colour I picked, sometimes I would get 40,45 mushrooms, other times single digits or 0.Im not sure about the forest scene, it does not seem like waiting to press space at the last possible moment helps with the number of mushrooms.
